setup.zh: 渡口的灯在雨里晃。提灯的是渡叔，在这条河上撑了一辈子船。
setup.en: The crossing's lantern sways in the rain. It is Du Shu who holds it; he has poled a boat on this river all his life.

recap.zh: 渡口，渡叔问你叫什么——明日沉鼎观开山门，三年一回。
recap.en: At the crossing Du Shu asked your name: tomorrow Chending Temple opens its gate, once in three years.

text.zh: 大水天还往河边跑，你爹娘在的时候……罢了。手里拿的什么？
text.en: Running to the river in a flood. When your mother and father were alive… never mind. What's that in your hand?

text.zh: 你把铃攥进袖子里。渡叔看了你一眼，没有再问。
text.en: You close the bell into your sleeve. Du Shu looks at you once and does not ask again.

text.zh: 明日沉鼎观开山门，三年一回。你那点灵性，窝在渡口可惜了。
text.en: Tomorrow Chending Temple opens its gate — once in three years. That spark in you is wasted at a ferry landing.

text.zh: 去吧。去之前，先告诉我——观里的人问你叫什么，你怎么答？
text.en: Go. But first tell me: when they ask your name up there, what will you answer?

exits.means: gives a name to be called by, and whether a girl or a boy — the page card asks it: offered names to tap, or the player's own

text.zh: {name}。好名字。去了观里，别说是我荐的。
text.en: {name}. A good name. Up there, don't say I sent you.
